为子元素添加气泡确认框。.en-us: Add a confirmation popup to a child element.

设置参数`description`控制描述信息内容。.en-us: Use `description` to set the description content.

设置参数`icon`控制图标内容。.en-us: Use `icon` to set the icon content.

控制参数`arrow`隐藏气泡确认框附带的箭头。.en-us: Use `arrow` to hide the confirmation popup arrow.

控制参数`placement`设置不同的悬浮层展开方向。.en-us: Use `placement` to set the popup direction.

气泡确认框的展开状态可通过回调进行控制。.en-us: Control confirmation popup visibility through callbacks.

通过回调函数监听确认、取消按钮的点击事件。.en-us: Monitor Confirm and Cancel button clicks through callbacks.

当直接将**AntdPopconfirm**施加于具有绝对定位样式的元素之上时，.en-us: Applying **AntdPopconfirm** directly to an absolutely positioned element may produce incorrect popup placement. Wrap it in a **Span** and apply the absolute positioning styles to that wrapper.
